description: Rewrite the user's résumé for a specific job. Uses one unit of the monthly résumé allowance. Takes 30–120 seconds. Returns the tailored résumé text — show it to the user and refine it with them in conversation rather than regenerating, since each call costs another unit. If you also want a cover letter and ATS score, call start_apply_with_ai instead: it runs in the background and cannot time out.

force.description: Regenerate even if a result already exists, or if the match score is low. Spends allowance. Only set this when the user asks.

resume_id.description: Which stored résumé to use. Omit to use the default. Call list_my_resumes to see the options.

name: tailor_resume
title: Tailor a résumé to a job
